An interactive fiction by Wanqi WuA read receipt isn’t the whole story.

What a receipt leaves out.

Two fictional moments share one message and one read receipt. Bring the windows together, then align both clocks to 12:04 to see the part the sender cannot see.

The second scene is another possibility, not the next event. Neither scene lets us read someone’s mind.

Drag a title bar or use its arrow keys. “Bring closer” also works. Sound is optional.
